<reason>PRO won the core distinction and the default-rule fight. B proved synthetic dubbing is new speech plus a permanent reusable model, not just a new channel like streaming, and turned CON's take-it-or-leave-it point against boilerplate. B defused collapse by timing opt-in at hiring with union price, and exposed that CON already concedes purpose limits and itemization, leaving only whether the performer may say no. CON's legibility-vs-veto and custody replies were strong but never justified an opt-out default.</reason>
